---
title: "Open Science in the project lifecycle - plan & design "
date: today
---

::: {.callout-tip}
### Learning Objectives

By the end of this session, participants will be able to:

- Locate tools to assist in implementing Open Science into protocol writing, data analysis, and notetaking  
- Discuss the benefits of publishing in registered report format 
- Describe the importance of having a Data Management Plan (DMP) and working with data
according to the FAIR principles    
      
:::

**Exercise related tp data management plans**  
Option 1, reccomended for life scientist:  
Create a Data Management Plan (DMP) using [SciLifeLab Data Stewardship Wizard (DSW)](https://dsw.scilifelab.se/) following these instructions: [Write a DMP (part 1)](https://nbisweden.github.io/module-dmp-dm-practices/02-exercise-part1/index.html)  
  
Option 2:  
a) Find out if your organisation provides a DMP tool or template.  
b) Use SND's checklist for data management planning.  
1. Download the [Checklist for data management plans from SND](https://zenodo.org/records/6424769)  
2. Start at p.5 and go through the questions to see which ones are relevant to your project/situation.  
3. Start answering the relevant questions.
